figures.caption: 圖：被搶購一空的衛生紙貨架
figures.description: 賣場裡放衛生紙的貨架三層都空了，貨架上貼著一張寫著「售完」的告示，一位男店員站在空貨架旁邊，兩手一攤。右邊的結帳櫃台前排了一條長長的隊伍，隊伍裡的四個人各推著一台推車，每台推車裡都堆滿了同一種衛生紙。排在最後面的女士一邊排隊，一邊緊張地看著手機上「衛生紙要漲價了？」的新聞標題。

questions.stem: 提示：每當颱風要來，或是傳出某種商品可能缺貨、漲價的消息，賣場常出現民眾搶購的情形，貨架一下子就被搬空。請根據下圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中賣場的情景；第二段說明人們為什麼會搶購，以及搶購可能帶來的影響。

1.explanation_zh: 第一段描述圖中賣場的情景；第二段有兩個任務：人們為什麼會搶購，以及搶購可能帶來的影響。原因可以從害怕缺貨或漲價、從眾心理、消息傳播來寫；影響可以寫對其他消費者、對家庭或對社會的影響，最好用因果關係串起來。
evidence: 第二段說明人們為什麼會搶購
1.strategy_zh: 圖中女士手機上的漲價新聞是原因的線索，空貨架與「售完」告示是影響的線索：大家因為怕買不到而搶，結果真的讓別人買不到，第二段可以抓住這個因果寫得更深入。
hints: 第一段：先寫空貨架與店員，再寫結帳隊伍與推車，最後寫看新聞的女士
第二段前半：兩個搶購的原因，其中一個配合自己或家人的經驗
第二段後半：至少一項影響，最後提出一個避免搶購的做法或見解

moves.zh: 說明人們為什麼會搶購

content.focus_zh: 第一段要寫出三層全空、貼著「售完」告示的貨架與兩手一攤的店員，以及結帳隊伍裡推車堆滿同一種衛生紙的四個人、看著漲價新聞的女士；第二段要說明搶購的原因（怕缺貨或漲價、看到別人搶也跟著搶、消息傳得快等）與至少一項影響（真正需要的人買不到、囤積的東西浪費、價格上漲等），可以用自己颱風前採買或身邊的經驗支持。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段由空貨架寫到結帳隊伍與看新聞的女士；第二段先寫原因再寫影響，可以用因果鏈把「害怕、搶購、缺貨」串起來，結尾提出自己的見解或建議。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在進行式，寫經驗用過去式；注意 run out、go up 等片語動詞的時態，people who＋動詞的關係子句，以及 as much as possible、too much 的用法。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 搶購相關用語（panic buying、shelf、sold out、checkout、line up、shortage、run out、stock up）要用得準；shelf 的複數是 shelves，不要寫成 shelfs；避免整段只用 buy、many、things 這幾個字。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a supermarket during a wave of panic buying. The toilet paper shelves are completely empty, and a sign on them says “Sold Out.” A clerk is standing beside the shelves with his hands spread, showing that nothing is left. On the right, four shoppers are waiting in line at the checkout counter, and each of them is pushing a cart full of the same kind of toilet paper. The woman at the end of the line is reading a news story on her phone, which says that toilet paper prices will rise.
People rush to buy things for several reasons. First, when they hear that something may run out or become more expensive, they worry and want to buy as much as possible before it is too late. Second, when people see others filling their carts, they often follow them without thinking. For example, before a typhoon last year, my mother and I went out to buy bottled water, but the shelves were almost empty, so we had to try three other stores. Panic buying can also cause serious problems. To begin with, people who need the products most, such as older people or families with babies, may not be able to get them. In addition, much of the extra food may go bad at home. Therefore, we should stay calm and buy only what we need. In short, panic buying makes a small problem much bigger.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：空貨架與售完告示、兩手一攤的店員、推車堆滿衛生紙的結帳隊伍與看新聞的女士

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述涵蓋空貨架、告示、店員、結帳隊伍與看新聞的女士，兩個原因配合颱風前買水的經驗，兩項影響也有，結尾提出做法（內容 4）；列舉、舉例、因果與總結的轉承清楚（組織 4）；句子正確，有關係子句、as much as possible 與 make＋受詞＋形容詞（文法句構 4）；用字正確但偏基本，buy、people 重複（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
In the picture, a supermarket appears to have been hit by a storm of shoppers rather than a storm of rain. The toilet paper section has been stripped bare; all three shelves are empty except for a sign that reads “Sold Out,” and a clerk standing beside them can only spread his hands helplessly. A few meters away, four customers wait in a long line at the checkout, each pushing a cart piled high with exactly the same kind of toilet paper. The woman at the back of the line is staring at her phone, where a headline warns that toilet paper prices are about to rise. Judging from her worried expression, that single headline may be the reason the whole line exists. The scene looks less like an ordinary shopping trip than a race against an invisible clock.
Panic buying is driven less by real shortages than by fear. When people hear that a typhoon is coming or that prices may go up, they imagine the worst and decide that it is safer to buy too much than too little. Fear also spreads quickly. Once shoppers see photos of empty shelves online, even those who planned to buy nothing begin to worry and rush to the store as well. I experienced this myself before a typhoon last summer: my mother and I only went out for bread and bottled water, but after seeing other customers fill their carts, we came home with three packs of instant noodles that we did not really need. Ironically, panic buying creates the very shortage people fear. Because a few customers take far more than their share, elderly people and families with babies, who cannot easily hurry from store to store, are left with nothing. Moreover, much of what is hoarded, such as fresh food, simply expires in people's kitchens. To break this cycle, stores can limit how many items each customer may buy, and the government can publish accurate information about supplies early. In the end, the best protection against a shortage is not a full cart but a calm mind.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：以颱風作比喻，寫出空貨架、店員、結帳隊伍與女士手機上的新聞，並推測新聞就是隊伍出現的原因

notes.text: is not a full cart but a calm mind
notes.zh: not A but B：不是 A 而是 B

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述以「被人潮而不是暴雨襲擊」開場，細節完整，並由女士的神情推出排隊的原因；第二段以「恐懼」為核心寫出原因與擴散，以自己颱風前多買泡麵的經驗佐證，再用因果鏈說明搶購反而造成缺貨、弱勢買不到與生鮮過期，提出限購與公開資訊的做法，結尾提出見解（內容 5）；原因、經驗、影響、做法、結論層次分明（組織 5）；less by A than by B、the very、not A but B、非限定關係子句皆正確（文法句構 5）；用字精確（stripped bare、hoarded、shortage），整體仍以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段寫出空貨架、售完告示、攤手店員、四人推滿同一種衛生紙的推車與看新聞的女士；第二段兩個原因（怕缺貨漲價、從眾）與兩項影響（需要的人買不到、食物放壞），結尾提出保持冷靜的建議。文法無誤；For example 的颱風前買水經驗較像說明缺貨的影響，與前一句「從眾」原因銜接稍弱，未點出貨架有三層。字彙恰當（panic buying、run out、checkout），屬穩健程度。

top.comment_zh: 以 a storm of shoppers rather than a storm of rain 開頭，細節完整（三層全空、Sold Out 告示、無奈攤手的店員、四台推車、看漲價標題的女士），並推論標題是整條隊伍的起因；第二段以恐懼與恐懼擴散說明原因，親身經驗具體，再以 Ironically 帶出搶購造成短缺、弱勢買不到、囤貨過期等影響，最後提出限購與公開資訊的解方，因果鏈清楚。句型高階、用字精準（stripped bare、hoarded），無錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段寫出空貨架與「Sold Out」告示、兩手一攤的店員、四位推車堆滿衛生紙的顧客與看漲價新聞的女士；第二段有兩個原因（怕缺貨漲價、跟著別人買）、兩項影響（需要的人買不到、食物壞掉）與颱風前買水的經驗，結尾有建議。文法正確、條理清楚，但影響的細節較簡略，buy、things 重複較多。

top.comment_zh: 第一段以「人潮風暴而非雨」破題，空貨架、售完告示、店員、四輛推車與看新聞的女士都寫到；第二段以因果鏈說明恐懼、跟風、反而造成缺貨，加上颱風前多買泡麵的親身經驗、對老人與嬰兒家庭的影響與限購等具體建議，結尾回扣。句型多變，stripped bare、hoarded、expires 等用字精準，未見錯誤。
